assetBriefDefaults.captionSafeArea: Keep principal focal details within art; reserve dialogue/status/control text for the existing runtime scene owner. Do not bake text into illustrations except approved established costume/vehicle insignia.
assetBriefDefaults.sourceHandling: Preserve original supplied/reference assets and generated sources unchanged; record every selected source hash, prompt and ordered references. Any runtime conversion must document its actual parameters.
assetBriefDefaults.identityPriority: Canonical face, makeup, cap/insignia, costume and five-finger anatomy take priority over style invention.

deliveryRules: This manifest records production dependencies, not shipped scenes or final canon.
Generated hero concepts remain review assets outside runtime until selected and integrated.
Null contributor/credit/reference values are unrecorded, not a claim of absent permission or private-photo status.
Reference availability claims are limited to the audited files; do not claim a photo is missing everywhere.
Do not infer supplied music or voice from visual inclusion.
Preserve the successful Level 2 delivery, Bass award and saved handoff.
The rejected Contra-style preview does not become Mac's authored Level 3.
